LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_AltT: Allow toggling the interface with the alt-key.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Hide: Hide the interface completely when toggled.

LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_BoundingBoxBa: Toggle using Designator Shapes shape-based bounding box.
Base bounding box on shape instead of mouse input.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Rest: Restrict flood fill to revealed cells

When enabled, flood fill cannot start in or pass through fogged cells or concealed natural rock. Natural rock and resource ore must have a face exposed to an unfogged cell that is neither linked as rock nor fully blocked by an edifice; hidden interiors of ore veins are excluded until exposed by mining. Disabled by default to preserve the existing ore-scouting behavior.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_ConfirmDestru: Apply {0} to {1} cells? Cancelling keeps the tool selected and changes nothing.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Addi: Selected buildings, their blueprints and frames also stop ordinary region fill. Existing barriers remain. Starting on matching walls or ore still fills that same type. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Canc: Escape or right-click cancels the current stroke while keeping the tool
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Conf: Ask once before flood-fill mining, deconstruction, cutting plants, removing floors, or cancelling designations and deleting plans. Previewing changes nothing. Disabled by default.
LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Reme: Remember a shape for each designator

Remember explicit shape choices per designator type and building or floor definition in this save (up to 512 entries). A remembered choice takes priority over auto-select; unseen tools use the existing auto-select/global fallback. Reset shape on resume also clears this memory.

LanguageData.Merthsoft_DesignatorShapes_Settings_Togg: Press a key or key combination for the interface toggle. To bind Alt, Ctrl, or Shift alone, press and release it. Escape cancels; Backspace clears.
